critique: The note proves the advertised order-sharp finite-sample minimax MSE frontier on the full stated observed-law class, including matching achievability and an all-measurable-estimator converse; “matched” is justified only up to epsilon-dependent constants. It does not establish the sharp leading constant posed in sharp-overlap-constant, and the framing correctly leaves that question open. The claimed direct operational relevance is not delivered by the theorem because the Rao–Blackwellized tensor-polynomial estimator has no polynomial-time or numerically stable implementation guarantee. The settled object remains the scalar oracle-value risk under binary treatment, binary outcome, and fixed overlap, rather than learned-policy regret or inference, which limits the contribution to field tier.
